description: Deploy a static website to Edge in one call: creates a storage bucket, uploads files (or clones a git repo), configures the global CDN with SSL, and wires DNS if the zone is on Edge. Free tier covers it. Provide either files (base64) or a git repo.

domain.description: Custom domain to serve from, e.g. "app.example.com". SSL is auto-provisioned.

dry_run.description: Preview the action without executing it. Returns what would happen, including cost estimates. Always dry-run first for anything that costs money.

git_token.description: Personal access token for private repositories

project.description: Project name (created if it does not exist), e.g. "my-portfolio"

repo.description: Git repository to deploy instead of files: "user/repo" or a full GitHub/GitLab URL

source_path.description: Subdirectory of the repo to deploy, e.g. "dist" or "build"

spa_mode.description: Enable single-page-app mode (all routes serve index.html)

name: edge_deploy_static_site
